title: Unify focus + contrast patterns for interactive legends, filter pills, and density toggle; assemble VPAT evidence
creator: Marisol Gomez
description:
Problem: Interactive legends, filter pills, and the compact/dense toggle across dashboards currently use inconsistent focus rings, rely on color alone for state, and lack a single screen-reader announcement strategy. This causes regressions in keyboard-only workflows and creates gaps in VPAT evidence for keyboard and perceivable sections.

Goal: Create a unified accessibility pattern for these controls that: 1) standardizes focus and active/selected contrast using tokens, 2) ensures keyboard/aria behavior is consistent across charts, tables, and filters, and 3) produces VPAT-ready test artifacts (screenreader transcripts, contrast checks, and keyboard-flow videos).

Scope: Legend controls (chart legends and series toggles), filter pill components (multi-select chips), compact/dense layout toggle, and associated tokens (focus, selected, hover). Work includes design specs, token recommendation, short prototyping kit, handoff notes, and VPAT evidence bundle.
acceptance_criteria: Design specs include clear token mappings for focus/hover/selected/disabled states that meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for UI components and 3:1 for non-text),
Keyboard tab order documented and validated for chart legend, filter list, and density toggle across small/large density layouts
Screen-reader announcement pattern defined (aria-pressed vs checkbox role) and validated with NVDA/VoiceOver/JAWS transcripts
Interactive prototype + Figma components updated with accessible focus tokens and an example of focus-visible only interactions
VPAT evidence bundle (transcripts, contrast reports, test plan, video) added to Confluence and linked from ticket
decisions: Use 'button' role with aria-pressed for legend series toggles to preserve semantic action and allow toggle state announcements
Adopt a single focus token 'focus-ring-2' with 3px outline for interactive legend items across density variants; token maps to color token 'accent-600' at 3.5:1 on top of component background
Filter pills will switch to an explicit selected state that includes a 1.5px inset border and updated token 'pill-selected-bg' to meet minimum contrast
Density toggle to remain a segmented control but expose keyboard navigation via Left/Right arrows and explicit aria-live region for layout change announcement
qa_plan: Manual keyboard walkthrough: tab to legends, use arrow/space/enter to toggle; confirm focus order matches spec
Screen reader pass: record NVDA and VoiceOver transcripts when toggling legend items, activating filter pills, and flipping density toggle
Contrast audit: run axe-core + color-contrast tool on each state token against backgrounds used in charts and dense tables
Cross-browser smoke: Chrome/Firefox/Safari on Mac/Win + NVDA/VoiceOver basic validation
notes: We observed inconsistent focus rings in production dashboards: some legend items used box-shadow while others used outline and focus color differed by chart type.
Design tokens will require a small runtime mapping change so that charts injecting custom backgrounds still reference the new accessible tokens.
Estimate assumes eng work to land a small feature flag for the segmented density toggle behavior that can be rolled out to 10% first.
VPAT: need to coordinate with legal for final packaging; this ticket will assemble the draft evidence only.
